source_specific_conventions.headings: Use # for 第21章, ## for each numbered section, and ### for each numbered 問題. Preserve the seven source section titles and do not flatten sections.
source_specific_conventions.locators: Physical page IDs W2:NNN are separate from printed labels 21-N; section citations may share a page only inside the single owning batch and must name the source region and destination heading.
source_specific_conventions.page_ownership: JPG-W2-C001 owns every included physical page W2:004-W2:021 exactly once; there are no excluded pages in this batch.
source_specific_conventions.content: Designated JPGs are authoritative. Preserve question wording, importance and past-question labels, verdicts, citations, explanations, conditions, exceptions and additional-check notes. PDF is identity/planning support only.
source_specific_conventions.tables_and_diagrams: No diagram- or table-only meaning occurs in this pilot; no source figure or table is silently omitted.
source_specific_conventions.format: Source Markdown contains no bold, Cloze, Front/Back, integration or card output. Only presentation decoration was normalized; no learner-content correction was required.
source_specific_conventions.question_layout: Every source question remains a numbered ### topic with its problem statement and 判定; source-printed 出典 and 解説 fields are retained where present. Incorrect propositions remain explicitly labelled 誤り; 正しい statements remain labelled 正しい. 追加でチェック notes remain attached to their source question.
